title: Hypnobox
description: Frontend development for the Hypnobox web platform, built with Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS and integrated with a Headless WordPress and WooCommerce backend through GraphQL. My work included implementing responsive user interfaces and reusable frontend components, as well as supporting the e-commerce experience, including product flows and the shopping cart.

title: Testberichte.de
description: Worked as a Frontend Developer on one of Germany's largest independent consumer portals. My work included implementing a new mobile-first sticky navigation and developing approximately 80% of the elements displayed on the homepage. I also contributed to resolving frontend issues, maintaining frontend standards and improving performance and Core Web Vitals, including CLS optimization. In collaboration with designers and QA testers, I supported A/B testing of components, CTAs and affiliate advertisements to evaluate different variants and their performance.

title: AlloyTester
description: Developed responsive frontend interfaces for a corporate website using Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS, integrated with Storyblok as a Headless CMS. The project involved translating design requirements into responsive frontend interfaces and working within a component-based architecture.

title: Concentro
description: Built and adapted the frontend of a corporate website using Nuxt.js, Tailwind CSS and Storyblok as a Headless CMS. The project was built using a shared frontend template that was adapted to the client's requirements through custom styling and CSS changes, while also implementing components with project-specific visual variations.

title: Med-Spezialisten
description: Implemented and adapted the frontend of a corporate website using Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS, integrated with a Headless WordPress backend. The project involved adapting a shared frontend template to the client's visual requirements, implementing responsive layouts and adjusting styling and components to match the project's design.

title: Doc-Spezialisten
description: Frontend development for a corporate website using Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS, integrated with a Headless WordPress backend. The project was based on a shared frontend template and adapted through CSS and styling changes, with component variations implemented to reflect the visual requirements of the website.

title: Vilo Personal
description: Frontend development for a corporate website using Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS, integrated with a Headless WordPress backend. The website was built from a shared frontend template and customized for the project through responsive styling, CSS adjustments and component-specific visual variations.

title: Pizza Courses
description: Built and delivered a responsive WordPress website for an independent pizza consulting business. The project was developed from implementation to final delivery using WordPress and the Divi visual page builder.
